name.description: Name of the company, e.g. Acme.

directorPositionId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
directorPositionId.description: Id of the director's position, i.e. the name of its folder in .aico/positions: the company's management, held by no employee: the people working on the repository, identified by git, write from it. It can't be deleted.

maxTaskDepth.description: How deep a chain of tasks may grow, each created from an event of the one before, such as LLM employees mentioning each other: beyond it, AICo creates no task and records chain-stopped in the journal. A person's message starts again from 0. 200 when absent.

title: AICo company
description: Configuration of the company, in .aico/company/config.json. Its description lives next to it, in description.md.
